metadata.title: Simple Usability Tracker
metadata.description: Tracks clicks, mouse movement, and scroll depth to build heatmaps.
metadata.author: Student Project

usage.step: Open your page and click around, move the mouse, and scroll.
In the browser console run: UsabilityTracker.getSummary()
Run: UsabilityTracker.renderHeatmap() to see dots on the page.
Run: UsabilityTracker.downloadJSON() to save the data.
